description: Expected (client_lane, protocol) pairs the docker/client-compat matrix must produce evidence for on every nightly run. scripts/client-compat/diff-baselines.py uses this manifest in --strict mode to fail when any pair is missing from BOTH baseline and current run, so a never-baselined lane cannot silently disappear from the gate. Bump alongside the matrix in docs/gis/CROSS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATION_MATRIX.md when a lane × protocol is added or retired.
